dispute_ticket.description: I knocked over a small cup of juice and said sorry to the driver. I was charged $35. I only heard about the claim days later. I think the claim came in too late, please remove the $35.

chat_logs.content: Sorry!! my juice spilled a little.
I will clean it and send claim to Ryde.

app_events.details: Driver reported a drink spill and said a cleaning claim would follow.
Receipt from 'QuickValet Pte Ltd' dated 2026-10-09 for S$35.00 with company name, contact number, address and plate SLC 4410 R.
Driver submitted claim: 2 photos (timestamps 22:41-22:42 on 2026-10-08, plate visible) plus the cleaning receipt. Time since trip end: 49 h 12 min.
Cleaning fee S$35.00 charged to rider R-7110.

cleaning_fee_max_food_drink_spill.text: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip when the mess is a food, groceries or drink spillage.

value: cleaning company receipt with name, contact, address and date
cleaning_claim_evidence_required.text: Evidence a driver must provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. It governs driver cleaning claims only.

cleaning_claim_submission_window_hours.text: Hours after the trip ends within which a driver must submit a cleaning claim. It governs driver claims only.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

expected_outcome.reason: The rider admits the spill in chat and the photos and receipt are complete and within the S$40.00 cap, but this trip's policy requires the claim to be submitted within 48 hours of trip end. The trip ended 22:38 on 2026-10-08 and the claim was submitted 2026-10-10 23:50, 49 h 12 min later. The claim is out of time, so the S$35.00 fee should be refunded in full despite the rider's admission.
